initialInput: I would like a talker time app, that allows me as a I rehearse my talk to keep track of how long a section take. So it should be able to label each lapse (and possibly edit it) to say what is was for, including takes, and at the end get a sense of how long the talk will be depending on how things are assembled. The UI should be very zen, as the focus is on the talk, and it should be easy to pop it in and hide it back.

proposedRequirements.text: Timer displays elapsed time in minutes and seconds format (MM:SS)
A single tap or keypress creates a lap marker at the current elapsed time
Each lap records the duration from the previous lap marker (or start) to the current marker
Sessions are organized hierarchically: a Talk contains Sections, each Section contains one or more Takes
Each lap can be labeled with a section name after it is recorded
All takes are preserved with their timestamps and durations
Each section automatically selects its best take (shortest duration) for total talk time calculation
Total estimated talk duration is computed by summing the best take from each section
All lap and label actions support undo and redo operations
The undo/redo stack preserves complete action history for the session
The app provides a translucent overlay mode that stays visible but unobtrusive during rehearsal
Visual design uses soft muted colors for minimal distraction
A soft visual indicator shows progress toward a target talk duration when set
Sessions can be exported as Markdown summaries
All primary functions are accessible via keyboard shortcuts for hands-free operation
The app can be quickly shown and hidden during rehearsal

proposalSummary: A zen-focused talk rehearsal timer that tracks section durations through simple lap markers. Organized hierarchically (Talk > Sections > Takes), it keeps all timing attempts and auto-selects the best take per section for total duration estimation. Features include inline labeling after each lap, full undo/redo support, translucent overlay mode for unobtrusive rehearsal, and complete keyboard control. Data is managed through file export/import with Markdown summary output.
